changes: done_prepare now emits explicit post-validation closeout progress labels and applies independent phase deadlines to closeout work, including synchronous execFileSync and execSync git probes.
usage: Run lattice done_prepare as before; during closure it reports progress such as evaluating DONE closure, checking clean tree, and computing runtime-change status while preserving JSON stdout in --json mode.
expectedOutcome: Users and agents should no longer see a silent done_prepare closeout after validation; a hung closeout phase should fail closed with an attributed phase timeout before the global idle watchdog.
actualTranscript: lattice validate --story=B-eb08 --json --forceTakeover ran 43 configured commands and ended with status pass. Focused smoke npm --prefix packages/main run test:done-prepare-closure-heartbeat-smoke passed, including human progress labels, JSON side-channel behavior, diagnostic-only evidence, runtimeChange hang timeout, and doneClosure execSync hang timeout coverage.
outcomeDiff: No difference remains; expected closeout liveness and fail-closed behavior were observed after reviewer-found sync hang gaps were resolved.
limitations: none - fully covered by focused smoke, full validate, reviewer receipts, and delivery review pending final signature.
pitfalls: The major pitfall was sync child-process coverage: execFileSync and execSync both needed bounded closeout wrappers, and the smoke needed execSync-only targeting so earlier execFileSync probes could not satisfy the regression.
